name: @mara/desktop-spike
description: MARA Desktop pre-development process and UI spike

scripts.build: npm run build:electron && npm run build:renderer
scripts.package:linux: npm run sidecar:bundle && npm run build && node scripts/package-app.mjs linux
scripts.package:windows: npm run sidecar:bundle && npm run build && node scripts/package-app.mjs win32
scripts.test: npm run test:electron && npm run test:renderer && npm run test:sidecar && npm run test:packaging
scripts.test:renderer: tsc -p tsconfig.renderer-test.json --noEmit && node --import tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 src/*.test.ts src/*.test.tsx src/components/*.test.ts src/components/*.test.tsx
scripts.test:sidecar: node scripts/run-python.mjs -m unittest discover -s sidecar -t . -p test_*.py
scripts.verify: npm run contracts:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
